target: Existing marker-consistent macrophage AND symbol-summed PGAM5 raw count > 0; zero means RNA undetected
supplementary: GSE140228 HCC-only, with Droplet/Smartseq2 separated; GSE125449 overlapping GSE151530; GSE146115 low support. GSE154906 remains cancelled
definition: Retain existing conservative macrophage memberships, all cycling cells and raw zero values. Do not rename a proliferation state PGAM5-specific
feature_universe: Exact symbols measurable in all five primary cohorts; availability only, no external expression/outcome used
DE: Two-sided Mann-Whitney U on log1p(CP10k), asymptotic tie correction and continuity correction; BH over the common gene universe separately per cohort; exact linear meanCP10k log2FC with pseudocount 0.001
candidate_roles: PGAM5 forced as definition anchor, not independent evidence; lineage markers selected separately from target-state candidates; cycle genes retained and documented, with a no-cycle sensitivity
reference: Equal weights to each cohort then each available donor within each group; full competitors and Unknown_other retained; group-specific cell-mean CP10k for idealized equal-cell mixtures and pooled raw-count CPM for RNA-contribution mixtures
reference_group_support: At least 50 cells and 2 donor labels per active fine group; unsupported cycling groups collapse into their existing parent, other unsupported groups into Unknown_other; target and undetected macrophages required

configurations.FCLS: Nonnegative fractions constrained to sum one, ridge 0.001, analytic objective/Jacobian; robust uses 3 fixed Cauchy residual-weight updates with scale 1

validation: Nested leave-one-cohort-out across 5 primary cohorts; inner entire-cohort holdouts choose configuration by cohort-equal mean(MAE+2*zero95quantile+0.02*(1-max(r,0))), with undefined r treated as 0, training-only feature selection. All outer predictions reported, no choosing a method from outer outcomes. Previous retrospective data exploration acknowledged

mixtures.nonmacrophage: Observed held-out donor nonmacrophage pool, including unresolved cells; no tumor-label eligibility requirement
mixtures.eligible: At least 5 detected and 20 undetected macrophages, 200 nonmacrophages
mixtures.challenges: Target-absent PGAM5-detected nonmacrophages, cycling nonmacrophages, and pure competitor pools with >=20 cells; sampling with replacement, repeats not independent patients

units: equalized_cell_fraction is idealized, not native bulk. library_RNA_contribution is observed count contribution, not biologically calibrated cell fraction
TCGA: Outcome-blind primary-tumor selection; apply final fixed reference only after reporting nested performance. Any failed gates mean outputs exploratory coefficients, not target cell abundance. Bulk/scRNA platform matching and cell-RNA calibration remain separate requirements
constraints: No patient-paired DE, depth matching, depth covariate regression or partial correlation. Donor consistency and cohort holdouts are validation units, not paired DE. No outcome-based feature or threshold selection
